title: fix: LA expose web_search / structured search tools for live richer results UI
description:
## Context

Ship-QA lp-uxy.15.8 (shipped lp-uxy.7 web search / Firecrawl richer results UI)
against http://demo.localhost:3010 with Brain RPC → Lanyard Agent.

## Observation

Portal story `?story=web-search-results` **PASS** (structured cards + Firecrawl
badges + rich citation chips; cost-gated fixture path).

Live chat prompt to search the web received:

> No web_search or firecrawl tools available in this environment. Cannot perform
> live web search or cite current sources.

`FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` is intentionally **absent** (cost-gated). Host should still
expose a non-Firecrawl `web_search` (or document honest capability) so Portal can
render structured results / citations when the agent does search. Firecrawl_*
tools should refuse live calls without key (per docs/architecture/portal-web-search-firecrawl.md)
rather than omit all search tools.

## Done when

- LA advertises/uses at least one web search tool without requiring Firecrawl key, OR
  capabilities honestly report search unsupported.
- When search runs, tool_progress carries structured results parseable by
  portal webCitations / WebSearchResults (title, url, snippet, provider).
- Live re-QA of lp-uxy.15.8 live path shows Searching the web + structured cards
  or rich citations (or explicit capability-off honesty).

## Evidence

artifacts/ui/lp-uxy-ship-qa/web-search/ (12-live-chat-after-response.png, RESULT.md)

## Supersedes

title: Bind s3_vault_prefix override to tenant_id + validate on ensure_online
description:
Residual from lp-m2z security review.

## Problem
Provision path accepts optional s3_vault_prefix override without binding it to the register tenant_id. normalizeOptionalS3VaultPrefix only normalizes trailing slash/length. Test provision-daytona.test.ts allows tenants/custom/vault for an unrelated tenantId.

Normative layout (s3-vault-prefix-layout.md) requires shape ^tenants/{tenant_id}/vault/$ (or multi-instance form) and ensure_online refuse if prefix fails validation. IAM session policy is rendered from CP s3_vault_prefix — a mis-set foreign prefix would grant that foreign tree to the sandbox session.

Service-token surface only (not end-user), but defense-in-depth is missing.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Reject s3_vault_prefix override that does not match tenants/{tenant_id}/vault/ or multi-instance form for the same tenant_id
- [ ] ensure_online / buildCreateParams refuses wake when stored prefix fails shape or tenant segment mismatch
- [ ] Unit tests for foreign prefix reject + default path unchanged
- [ ] Update provision-daytona tests that currently allow tenants/custom/vault

## Evidence
docs/plans/0008-daytona-agent-sandboxes/security-review-vm-secrets-egress-s3.md §4.5 / §11
portal/packages/control-plane/src/provision-daytona.ts
portal/packages/control-plane/src/sandbox-vault-mount.ts
notes: Implemented tenant-bound s3_vault_prefix validation. Draft PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/308 commit e2dfc6d. Acceptance: provision/update bind + ensure_online re-validate + unit tests. Not closed pending review.
close_reason: Done. PR #308.

title: Vault many-small-file I/O: guest cache or redesign for Mountpoint
description:

Mountpoint S3 vault is GO for sparse I/O; NO-GO for agent patterns that open/read/write hundreds of tiny files per turn without a guest cache (100×64B reads ~8.5s; 100 writes ~27s). Append/in-place write fails on Mountpoint.

title: Web search upgrade: richer results, Firecrawl / X / external providers
description:
## Clarification
Omnibox Mode A is OS sandbox for host-impacting tool children — NOT a search omnibox UI. Web search today is host tools (web_search / tavily / brave / etc.) with Portal labeling ("Searching the web") and URL citation chips. No monorepo search engine; no X or Firecrawl integration found in platform contracts.

**Provider intent (product):** upgrade search with **Firecrawl** (crawl/scrape/extract for agent-usable page content) and optionally **X** search — not Firebase.

## Goals
Make web search much more functional than current label+URL chips: structured results, better page content via Firecrawl, richer Portal presentation.

## Work
1. Product pick provider stack: improve existing host web_search; add/integrate **Firecrawl** for crawl/scrape/map; optional X search API
2. Host emits structured results (title, snippet, url, published_at, optional extracted markdown/content) in tool_progress / citations
3. Portal: richer citation cards, expandable result list in tool row, optional source chips in final answer
4. Secrets/env slots in deploy secrets pattern for Firecrawl API key (+ X if used)
5. Live QA against pilot pin

## Non-goals
Confusing Omnibox Mode A with search; building a Chrome-style address bar unless product renames.

## Related
Epic lp-uxy; hermes-lanyard-tool-citations-contract; webCitations.ts
acceptance_criteria:
- Firecrawl (and any other chosen providers) documented and secret-wired for pilot
- Chat shows structured search/crawl results beyond bare URLs (title/snippet and/or extracted content summary)

title: Project delete semantics: soft-archive honesty + optional workspace purge
description:
## Problem / research answer
Portal Directory delete is soft-archive of the agent project registry (projects.db): it leaves the list and does NOT delete vault/workspace folders. Confirm dialog already says vault files stay on disk. Contract brain-rpc currently lacks formal projects.delete (Portal already calls it).

## Product choices
A) Keep soft-archive forever — contractize + host proof only
B) Add optional \"Delete project and purge workspace\" with double-confirm (destructive)

## Work
1. Add projects.delete to brain-rpc.schema.json + capabilities + examples + validate-brain-rpc
2. Host verify archive-only default (HL + LA when projects exist)
3. UI: keep copy accurate; if product chooses B, implement purge RPC + dangerous confirm
4. Refresh deploy/references/brain-rpc-contract.md if stale

## User question answer for handoff
Today: registry unlist only; files remain on agent workspace disk.
acceptance_criteria:
- projects.delete is normative in backend-runtime-v1 with {id, archived:true} default semantics
- Portal confirm copy matches host behavior
- If purge is implemented: double-confirm and capability gate; default remains soft-archive

title: Handoff: Lanyard Agent system prompt — Portal chart/table rich blocks
description:
## Why
Portal already renders inline charts/tables when assistant markdown contains ```chart / ```table fences (lp-a79). Live chat does not show them when the user asks for a chart because **Lanyard Agent is never instructed** to emit those fences. Host inclusion was explicitly deferred in the monorepo catalog.

## What to do (Lanyard Agent repo)
1. Locate the system prompt or prompt pack used for Portal chat sessions.
2. Add the fragment from `lanyard-platform/docs/plans/0009-portal-chat-charts/agent-chart-catalog.md` § Prompt fragment (copy-paste).
3. Ship/redeploy Lanyard Agent with that prompt.
4. Prove live: in Portal, ask for a chart and a findings-style table; confirm fences appear and Portal paints PortalChartCard / PortalTableCard (not only story routes).

## Evidence to attach on close
- Path of prompt file(s) changed in Lanyard Agent
- Screenshot or session excerpt of live agent reply with ```chart and ```table
- Optional: note any LA-specific packaging (skill name, pack version)

## Ownership
- Implementation: Lanyard Agent (external)
- Schema/docs: Portal monorepo (already done)
design:
## Source of truth (Portal monorepo)
- Catalog: docs/plans/0009-portal-chat-charts/agent-chart-catalog.md
- Copy-paste fragment: section \"Prompt fragment (copy-paste)\" in that file
- Renderers (already shipped): ChatRichCodeBlock → PortalChartCard / PortalTableCard

## Target host

## Inclusion points (pick in LA repo)
- Primary system prompt / persona for Portal-facing sessions, **or**
- Versioned prompt pack / skill loaded when chat is served to Portal.

## Behavior to encode
When numbers benefit from visualization or the user asks for a chart/graph → fence language `chart` (or `chart-json`) with ChartSpecV1 JSON.
When inventories/findings/comparisons need badges or vault/external links → fence language `table` (or `table-json`) with TableSpecV1 JSON.
Prefer fences over ASCII art; prefer ```table over GFM pipes when badges/links matter.
No React/JSX; single JSON object per fence; version 1; chart types bar|line|area|pie; limits per catalog.
